name: Files
description: Every channel's files: a tree of its repository, with open, new folder, upload, rename, move, delete, and each file's history. Part of gild: in every channel, hide it or not.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: Every file in a channel, by path, with its size, and every folder. gild's own .gild/ folder isn't listed.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: A file's text, without touching the view.

path.description: The file's path, such as docs/intake-sop.md or forms/consent.txt.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a text file: its whole new text, at a path (folders on the way are made). A new file or a changed one; the same text changes nothing. One commit by you, in the channel's Activity. Needs write access.

path.description: Where the file goes, such as notes/2026-11-14.md. Not inside .gild/.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or a folder (everything in it moves). Nothing may already be at the new path. One commit by you. Needs write access.

path.description: The file or folder as it is now.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file, or a folder and everything in it. It stays in the channel's history (file_history shows the commit). One commit by you. Needs write access.

path.description: The file or folder to delete.

tools.name: file_history
tools.description: Every commit that changed a file (or anything in a folder), newest first: who, when, and the commit's message.
